title: 345 native selectors again: the run packs its per-case output and the packed record validates
description: The selector route of example 345 (four parent-fix tasks, every admitted selector checked natively on the real classpath, as job 20261120-213848-345-parent-fix-exhaust-native-selector-b ran it), on the commit where a run replaces each cases/ folder of its record with cases.tar.gz at its end and the validator reads a case from the folder or from the pack (examples/tools/targets/case_pack.py, VF-053). The first step is that run; its exit 1 is the outcome the earlier job had, since some of the four claims are refuted. The second step fails if any folder named cases is left under the example's selector records or the records are over the budget sync.py check holds them to. The third reads the example's claim history, which validates every retained record through the packs, and fails if it cites no record of this run or reports a case as missing, altered or unreadable.
expected: All three steps pass: the run ends 0 or 1 as before, no loose per-case folder is left, and the claim history cites the new packed record with no missing or altered case.

resources.notes: The same run took 2m53s and 139 MiB as job 20261120-213848-345-parent-fix-exhaust-native-selector-b; the two checks after it take seconds.

steps.name: Prove original properties by complete native case analysis
steps.run: python3 examples/tools/build.py 345 --native-selectors bytes-parent-fix,count-parent-fix,page-parent-fix,positive-parent-fix --checker-seconds 90 --first 6; code=$?; echo "selector run exited $code"; test $code -le 1

steps.name: No per-case folder is left loose, and the records are within their budget
steps.run: python3 examples/tools/targets/case_pack.py budget 345 && python3 examples/tools/targets/case_pack.py verify 345 && test -z "$(find examples/345-paged-importer-upgrades/records/native-selectors/parent-fix -type d -name cases)" && ls examples/345-paged-importer-upgrades/records/native-selectors/parent-fix

steps.name: The claim history validates the packed record of this run
steps.run: new=$(ls examples/345-paged-importer-upgrades/records/native-selectors/parent-fix | sort | tail -1); python3 examples/tools/targets/workflow_handoff.py handoff 345 | NEW=$new python3 -c "import os, sys; t = sys.stdin.read(); bad = [w for w in ('does not exist', 'different raw checker output', 'cannot be read') if w in t]; print(len(t), 'bytes of claim history; cites', os.environ['NEW'], os.environ['NEW'] in t, '; failure phrases', bad); sys.exit(0 if t and not bad and os.environ['NEW'] in t else 1)"
